title_as_printed: Experimental methane solubility (m3/m3) in formation water (STP).

footnotes_as_printed.u: Standard uncertainties on u are u(T) = 0.1 K, u(P) = 0.01 MPa, u(S) = 0.15 m3/m3.

pressure_note: Pressure of the PVT cell held constant during sampling (controlled within 0.01 MPa); the paper does not say whether it is total or gas partial pressure; taken as total cell pressure

value.what: volume of dissolved methane at STP (273.2 K, 0.10 MPa) per volume of formation water; reference volume (liquid at cell conditions or at STP) not stated

composition.other_species: formation water simulated by aqueous NaHCO3, 0.23 mol/kg (molality as stated), density 1.0116 g/cm3 (Anton Paar DMA45); NaHCO3 is outside the six-ion set

conversion_needs: m3/m3 at STP to mole fraction or mol/kg needs the water volume reference state and density
notes: Printed as a matrix with T in rows and P (30-130 MPa) in columns; stacked here into one block per pressure (rule: side-by-side blocks stacked), each block a label row then six temperatures 353-453 K. The pressure of each block is set by group_rows (P.constant).
volume_basis_evidence: 'Methane solubility in formation water (m3/m3) and water content in the coexisting gas phase (g/m3) were calculated under the same temperature and pressure.'; STP defined in Nomenclature as 273.2 K and 0.10 MPa; the denominator volume is not defined (liquid sample volume taken under pressure was recorded, mass of degassed liquid was weighed)
